children: ON 11 NOV A LETTER WAS PUBLISHED PUBLICLY RAISING TECHNICAL ACCOUNTING MATTER REGARDING SPARK'S FY26 FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
ACKNOWLEDGES CLASSIFICATION MATTER RAISED, DOESN'T CONSIDER THERE TO BE MATERIAL IMPACT TO FY26 FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AS RESULT
CONFIRMS THIS MATTER HAS NO EFFECT ON DELOITTE'S UNMODIFIED AUDIT OPINION
